option_relations.rationale: Polymorphous light eruption is a distinct photodermatosis not directly related to Parvovirus B19 infection.
Polymorphic light eruption is a distinct photodermatosis not directly related to Parvovirus B19 infection. It is a synonym for polymorphous light eruption.
Juvenile spring eruption (JSE) is a rare photodermatosis that has been associated with Parvovirus B19 infection, making it a manifestation of the infection.
Parvovirus B19-associated photodermatitis describes a skin condition triggered by light exposure in the context of Parvovirus B19 infection, making it a manifestation of the infection.
